_comment: Batch 9 (#42) global slot codemod. Source CSS from migration-source-v1 references these ~20 unprefixed shadcn-style custom properties across its 110 CSS files; every one must resolve to a --ds-* token before the file lands, so nothing unprefixed reaches a consumer's :root (direction.md decision 10). Component-local vars (--tone, --cell-radius, --panel-spacing, --transform-origin, --sidebar-*, Base UI positioner vars, drawer/toast animation state) are NOT in this table — they are scoped to their own rule and stay as-is. Re-applied by batch 16 on every source re-copy; edit here, not per-file.

literals._comment: Not tokens — the target defines no --ds-* equivalent, so the reference becomes the literal value directly. Precedent: chart.css, funnel-chart.css, code-block.css, treemap.css, waterfall-chart.css, snippet.css, toc.css all already do this for --font-mono.
literals.var(--font-mono): ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Geist Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
